title: docs(changelog): the 35827 note names GridCellSelectionProvider as the host to mount
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPm5yqPvuwrjEV9JhFTrVJj)_

Fixes #37521
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxEbSk19qJRPHrm3v9

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：纯文档。#35827 已发布的发版说明里，迁移表有两行叫宿主去挂 `GridCellSelection`，这是类型名，挂不上；改成要挂的组件 `GridCellSelectionProvider`。
- 为什么：PR #38097 已把运行时警告改对，发版说明还写着旧名字，照着做会编译不过。
- 影响谁：只影响读 CHANGELOG 的宿主开发者；没有行为变化，可整体撤回。
- 需要你：无。

## What changes
The migration table of the #35827 note ("the staged editing model is retired"), two rows, in six copies: the five published `CHANGELOG.md` entries (`@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/types`, each in its `19.0.0-next` section) and the consumed prerelease changeset `.changeset/pre/35827-data-table-staged-edit-retired.md`.

- Row `data-table` schema `onBatchSave: (changes) => …`, TO column. Before: "`onRowSave` inside a `GridCellSelection` host, or render `object-grid`". After: "`onRowSave` inside a `GridCellSelectionProvider` host, or render `object-grid`".
- Row "an editable `data-table` with no … host or no `onRowSave`". Before: "an editable `data-table` with no `GridCellSelection` host or no `onRowSave` | mount `GridCellSelection` and pass `onRowSave`, or render `object-grid`; until then it renders read-only and warns". After: "an editable `data-table` with no `GridCellSelectionProvider` host or no `onRowSave` | mount `GridCellSelectionProvider` and pass `onRowSave`, or render `object-grid`; until then it renders read-only and warns".

Nothing else in the note moves. The note's opening sentence, "edits only inside a select-first host (`GridCellSelection`)", names the model and is left as written; the other `GridCellSelection` mentions in these CHANGELOGs name the type's members (`GridCellSelection.confirmCommit`, `.describeCell`, `referenceCells`) and are correct.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

This PR rewrites a released note, the #35827 note, in its consumed changeset `.changeset/pre/35827-data-table-staged-edit-retired.md` and in the five CHANGELOG entries compiled from it.

- AGENTS.md *Documentation Guardrails*, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row: a factual error in a released entry is amended in that entry, in a dedicated docs-only PR.
- The consumed prerelease copy is changed byte-equal with the CHANGELOG rows (bar the CHANGELOG's two-space indent), so the stable cut, which re-applies consumed changesets, prints the corrected rows.
- The corrected sentences are quoted under *What changes* above.

Because the PR changes an existing changeset and adds none, `Check Changeset` is red by design; it carries no `skip-changeset` label.

## Why
`GridCellSelection` is the context's value type; the component a host mounts is `GridCellSelectionProvider`, exported from `@object-ui/components` beside it. PR #38097 (part 1 of #37521) corrected the runtime warning that said the same thing; this is the release-text half the card's contract record 7189751333 named.

## Verification
- `git diff origin/main --stat`: 6 files, 12 insertions, 12 deletions, two lines per file.
- The six copies of each corrected row are identical apart from the indent (`git diff`).
- `GridCellSelectionProvider` is the exported component name in `ui/packages/components/src/index.ts` and `ui/packages/components/src/context/gridCellSelection.tsx`.

## Human Minimum
- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no code)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing of its own; corrects a consumed note, see above)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (only its CHANGELOG)
- [ ] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. — one deliberate hand edit of a released CHANGELOG entry, the docs-only route AGENTS.md prescribes for a factual error.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the fleet's maintainer summary)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
